No opposition players, extra teammates or changed faces.

sharedPrompt:
Photorealistic Australian rules football IMAGE EDIT. Image 1 (MASTER) defines the athlete's body, pose, hands, ball, framing, background players, oval and floodlit NIGHT stadium. Image 2 (SELFIE) is the ONLY facial identity source for the central athlete. Replace the ENTIRE visible head from Image 1 with the person in Image 2: preserve their recognisable eyes, nose, mouth, jaw, face shape, skin texture and apparent age. FULL HEAD REPLACEMENT includes the selfie's actual hairstyle: hairline, cut, length, colour, texture, part, crown and sides. NEVER retain or mix the master athlete's face or hair. Do not invent, idealise or alter the person's identity. Adapt head angle and natural expression only as necessary to fit the pose. Blend the face, ears, neck and exposed skin seamlessly under the same floodlights: matching skin tone, shadows and texture, no pasted-on seam.

SELECTED TEAM OVERRIDES MASTER CLOTHING: Dress the central athlete in the selected playing guernsey style below, replacing the original master kit's colours, stripe direction and branding. In a celebration, dress EVERY visible celebrating teammate in that same selected team kit while retaining teammates' identities, positions and physical contact. Never leave the original Collingwood-style stripes on a player when a different team is selected. Preserve the master composition and all non-clothing scene elements. Do not copy the selfie background. No added people, duplicate limbs or balls, invented logos, captions or watermarks. Single vertical 9:16 photorealistic sports image.
